title: The 5 Best Car Seats for Small Cars
h1: The 5 Best Car Seats for Small Cars
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for car seats for small cars, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at car seats for small cars using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Chicco KeyFit 35 Infant Car Seat
products.blurb: Key specs: Compact base without an anti-rebound bar, Fits infants 4 to 35 pounds, Load leg for a shorter recline footprint.
strengths: One of the shallower infant seat bases available, which helps in short rear seats
Load leg design reduces how far the base needs to recline compared to bases without one
Widely reported as fitting well in compact sedans and small SUVs
limitations: Still needs a proper recline angle, which can push the front passenger seat forward in very small cars
Height limit around 30 inches means an earlier switch to a convertible seat
No anti-rebound bar option, which some parents specifically want
features: Compact base without an anti-rebound bar
Load leg for a shorter recline footprint
Level indicator for accurate recline angle

products.name: Britax Boulevard ClickTight Convertible Car Seat
products.blurb: Key specs: ClickTight installation through the vehicle seat belt path, Rear-facing 5 to 40 pounds, Narrow shell profile relative to its side impact protection.
strengths: ClickTight's belt-path install often seats the seat flatter against the vehicle seat than LATCH-only installs
Narrower shell than many convertible seats with comparable side impact protection
No separate base to store or misplace
limitations: Still one of the deeper convertible seats when reclined for rear-facing
Heavier to reposition between rows or vehicles than a lighter convertible
Anti-rebound bar version, if chosen, adds noticeable depth
features: ClickTight installation through the vehicle seat belt path
Narrow shell profile relative to its side impact protection

products.name: Evenflo Sonus Convertible Car Seat
strengths: Light and easy to move between cars
Budget price for a convertible seat
Compact enough for smaller back seats
limitations: Less legroom rear-facing than extended-legroom seats

products.name: Graco Contender Slim Convertible Car Seat

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
